model_annotations.English: The pie chart represents the distribution of a certain dataset across three different years: 2017, 2018, and 2019. There are a total of three slices in the chart, each corresponding to one of the years. The largest slice, representing the year 2019, occupies 46% of the chart and is colored blue. The second largest slice, representing the year 2018, is orange and accounts for 33% of the chart. The smallest slice, representing the year 2017, is green and makes up 21% of the chart. Each slice is labeled with the year it represents, the percentage it occupies, and the numerical value in parentheses. The chart does not include a legend, and the percentages are displayed inside the corresponding slices. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way; they are simply arranged in descending order of size, starting with the largest slice for 2019 and ending with the smallest slice for 2017.
